Bounds on a (2..9) and b (1..9) are taken directly from the stated 'at least / at most' ranges.
The sum constraint a+b <= 12 is kept as a separate constraint rather than folded into bounds.

(declare-fun a () Int)
(declare-fun b () Int)
(assert (>= a 2))
(assert (<= a 9))
(assert (>= b 1))
(assert (<= b 4))
(assert (= (+ a (* -2 b)) 0))
(assert (<= (+ a b) 12))
(check-sat)
(exit)
